# A template may call a method the receiver does not define: muxt derives the
# signature from the call (here a form argument) and declares it on the
# generated RoutesReceiver interface.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go build -o build

-- in.go --
package main

type T struct{}

func main() {}
-- template.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed template.gohtml
var templatesDir embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesDir, "template.gohtml"))
-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.20
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / F(form)"}}Hello, {{.}}!{{end}}
